name: deepseek
label: DeepSeek Harness
description: DeepSeek's open-source agent harness (dsh) driven in headless one-shot mode

check_ready.not_ready_message: Not configured — set DEEPSEEK_API_KEY (press e). The harness has no CLI sign-in.
check_ready.unreadable_message: DeepSeek Harness credentials could not be read. Re-enter DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in the Configure screen.

env_config.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
env_config.description: DeepSeek API key. Required — the agent runs with a private, empty DSH_HOME, so there is no saved dsh login to fall back on.

env_config.name: DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL
env_config.description: Optional gateway/proxy base URL. Leave blank for the public DeepSeek API.

env_config.name: DEEPSEEK_MODEL
env_config.description: Model id, e.g. deepseek-v4-flash. Leave blank to use the harness default.

env_config.name: DSH_PERMISSION_MODE
env_config.description: Filesystem boundary for tool use. workspace-write confines writes to the project directory; read-only forbids changes; danger-full-access removes the sandbox. Plan mode always forces read-only regardless of this setting.
